articles.summary: Agrees to Acquire 50.5% Interest Directly from Bruton Shareholders Executes Transaction Agreement to Acquire Remaining Shares of Bruton Limited by Merger Announces Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company,” “Seaways,” or “INSW”), one of the largest tanker companies worldwide providing energy transportation services for crude oil and petroleum products, today announced the execution of agreements to acquire Bruton Limited (OSL: BRUT) (“Bruton”), in a series of transactions that values Bruton at approximately $370 million. The transaction combines Bruton’s 4 VLCC vessels, including newbuildings, with Seaways diversified fleet of approximately 70 vessels across both the crude and product segments. articles.summary: International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company” or “INSW”) announced today that it plans to release third quarter 2026 results before market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will host a conference call for investors at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time (“ET”) on the same day. Conference Call Details: Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026 Time 9:00 AM ET Dial-in Numbers United States: +1 (833) 461-5787 International: +1 (626) 884-3620 Conference ID 887 862 972 A live webcast of the conference call will be available from the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://www.intlseas.com/ . Following the conclusion of the call, an audio replay will be available on the Events page of the Company’s website at www.intlseas.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations until November 4, 2027.
